sources.entry: Neural Networks and Deep Learning by Michael Nielsen

summary.name: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
summary.one_liner: A free online book by Michael Nielsen that teaches neural networks and deep learning from the ground up.
use_cases: understanding why deep networks are hard to train
summary.what_it_does: The page is the landing page for a free online book on neural networks and deep learning. It lists its chapters: using neural nets to recognize handwritten digits, how the backpropagation algorithm works, techniques for improving how neural networks learn, a visual proof that neural nets can compute any function, why deep neural networks are hard to train, and an appendix asking whether there is a simple algorithm for intelligence. It describes neural networks as a biologically inspired way for computers to learn from observational data, and deep learning as a set of techniques for learning in neural networks. A link points to chapter 1 for direct reading.
notable: Free online book written by Michael Nielsen
Includes a visual proof that neural nets can compute any function
Chapter on handwritten digit recognition as a running example
caveats: Page does not state the publication date or the book's license terms
Covers foundational concepts and does not mention framework or code tooling
